title: Prompt Manifest
description: Metadata for one versioned prompt (Appendix C.0.2). Validates prompt-library/**/manifest.yaml.

version.description: Semver version; bump on any template or schema change (drift tracking, E26).

model.description: Primary model id, e.g. gpt-4o, Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct.

fallback_model.description: Model used when the primary is unavailable/over budget (degradation §6.4).

tier.description: Task tier drives routing + token budget enforcement (cost control, E16).

inputs.description: Template variables injected at render time.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the LLM's structured output must satisfy (function-calling).

eval_baseline.description: Last golden-set metrics; CI fails on regression below these.

owner.description: GitHub username of the responsible owner.
